**Walmart had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2025, by about 0.5 percentage points.** I used figures I remember from the filings and did not search to check them.

- **Walmart** (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2025): operating income of about $29.35B on revenue of about $680.99B gives a margin of about 4.31%.
- **Costco** (fiscal year ended Aug 31, 2025): operating income of about $10.38B on total revenue of about $275.24B gives a margin of about 3.77%.

The difference is 4.31% − 3.77% ≈ 0.54 percentage points.
